description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages achieved by various models on a zero-shot classification task, with the vertical axis labeled “Accuracy (%)” ranging from 40% to 65% in 5% increments and the horizontal axis displaying six distinct model configurations. The models are represented by colored bars: a light gray bar for “RoBERTa w/o Exp.” (approximately 45% accuracy), a light blue bar for “LaSQuE (mean)” (approximately 55% accuracy), an orange bar for “LaSQuE” (approximately 46% accuracy), a green bar for “LaSQuE” (approximately 47% accuracy), a purple bar for “LaSQuE (syn2real)” (approximately 59% accuracy), and a dark gray bar for “LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)” (approximately 62% accuracy). The bars are arranged in a single group along the horizontal axis, with no explicit sorting or ordering, and each bar’s height corresponds to its respective accuracy percentage. The chart does not indicate any visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or annotations on specific bars.
